quote: In this study, we systematically analyze grammatical differences of LLM-generated vs. human-authored text...

The 'NYT' datasets from Muñoz-Ortiz et al. 2024 include the original New York Times (NYT) article lead paragraphs and LLM-generated texts obtained from 6 different LLMs by prompting them with the headlines together with the first 3 words of the lead paragraph.
Studying linguistic properties of LLM-generated text and comparing it to human-authored text is a topic of growing interest in the field of natural language processing (NLP).
